© Roscosmos / IKI / international consortium. Vega 2 launched from Baikonur 1984-12-21, 6 days behind Vega 1. Its descent module landed 1985-06-15 at 7.5°S 177.7°E on Venus, returning soil-composition X-ray spectra (anorthosite-norite-troctolite composition — first chemical analysis of Venusian highland material) before high-temperature failure. The Vega 2 balloon performed identically to Vega 1's at ~54 km, with both balloons drifting at ~240 km/h around the planet in opposite hemispheres for ~46 hours. The flyby bus continued to comet 1P/Halley for closest approach (8030 km) on 1986-03-09 — three days after Vega 1's encounter. Together the Vega buses returned the first close-up images of any cometary nucleus, with Vega 2's data refining Vega 1's position fix and feeding directly into the targeting solution for Giotto's much closer 596 km Halley flyby five days later.

首次对金星高地型土壤进行化学分析（阿佛洛狄忒陆，1985年）；与 Vega 1 配合的哈雷彗星相遇，为 Giotto 提供了瞄准依据

Vega 1 的孪生探测器，晚 6 天发射（1984-12-21），用于冗余备份，并与 Vega 1 配合形成哈雷彗星舰队的联合瞄准方案。Vega 2 的下降舱于 1985-06-15 在阿佛洛狄忒陆北侧的鲁萨尔卡平原着陆，用 XRF 光谱法发现了斜长岩—苏长岩—橄长岩物质——这是首次对金星高地型地壳做化学分析（其成分与月球高地相似，尽管着陆点本身是一片平原）。它的气球表现与 Vega 1 的相同，在相反的半球以约 240 km/h 的速度漂移。航天器本体于 1986-03-09 以 8030 km 的距离掠过哈雷彗星。两艘 Vega 的本体合力传回了首批彗核近距离图像，并修正了位置定位，使 Giotto 能在五天后尝试 596 km 的飞掠。
